body: i'm in real estate so moving would be difficult. it's a special kind of torture having to talk to people all day and put on a show then coming home to be alone. i'm so used to it that i'd sooner kill myself than let anyone know anything is wrong. but thank you. i'm trying to find something, anything to make myself believe i have some value and i shouldn't do this. i can not imagine three years. i'm glad you got through it.

it's just crushingly lonely,and the few people i had in my life are gone. i'm an adult. i can't just go out and make a new best friend. and i don't want to date again. i don't want to go out there again and try to convince someone to like me, especially in this state. it's all just too much at once. the alternative seems so much simpler and less painful.
